# AL1300: Avoid async void methods

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `Threading` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Al1300ToAl1303ThreadingAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Async void methods cannot be awaited, exceptions cannot be caught by the caller, and they complicate unit testing. Use async Task instead, unless the method is an event handler.
